locations.label: Carlisle - The Sands
locations.caveat: Operator event page combines Carlisle 2 October and Kendal 3 October. The date-to-venue assignment is from the official artist schedule; do not infer both nights are in Carlisle.

sources.observed: Showaddywaddy listed 2–3 October 2026 across The Sands Centre, Carlisle CA1 1JQ and Westmorland Hall, Kendal; the artist schedule assigns 2 October to Carlisle.
The Sands Centre is in Carlisle near Hardwicke Circus and the M6; UK location supported by Carlisle address and CA1 postcode.
sources.excerpt: The Sands Centre is situated next to Hardwicke Circus

locations.label: Rhyl - Pavilion Theatre
locations.caveat: The artist-linked individual event page returned a web fetch error. The venue's own current calendar and Visit Wales provide the identity and location.

sources.observed: Venue calendar lists Showaddywaddy on 10 October among October 2026 shows; footer gives Pavilion Theatre, East Parade, Rhyl, Denbighshire LL18 3AQ.
Visit Wales identifies Pavilion Theatre Rhyl at the same LL18 3AQ address and links the venue website; Rhyl is in Wales, United Kingdom.

locations.label: Runcorn - Brindley Theatre
locations.caveat: The linked Quay Tickets page enters a redirect loop. The 16 October 2026 performance is independently corroborated only to autumn 2026, without day. No venue/operator page independently confirms 5 November 2027; that date rests solely on the official artist schedule. Both dates use the same proven venue label and location.

sources.observed: Official theatre site, built and managed by Halton Borough Council, gives High Street, Runcorn, Cheshire WA7 1BG; it uses both The Brindley and Brindley Theatre.
Halton Borough Council's 2 September 2026 announcement names Showaddywaddy in The Brindley autumn programme in Runcorn; exact day comes from the artist's schedule.

locations.label: Stockport - Plaza
locations.caveat: The event page appeared in the live search index but direct web open returned HTTP 425; the official venue calendar also lists the same date.

sources.observed: Official Stockport Plaza event page lists Showaddywaddy on Friday 30 October 2026 at 19:30; search index reached the page while direct web fetch returned an error.
The Plaza identifies its address as Mersey Square, Stockport SK1 1SP; its UK mailing information confirms country GB.
sources.excerpt: The Plaza Mersey Square Stockport SK1 1SP
